votes.motion: Approve the variances for 234 S Row Road (offset to groundwater 24 inches and less than 12 inch inlet/outlet tee separation).

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 1564 Massachusetts Avenue (groundwater offset to 36 inches and inlet/outlet tee separation less than 12 inches).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by mayhew and second by jewell, the board voted to approve the variances. all in favor by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve the variances for 200 Pleasant Street (groundwater offset to 24 inches, inlet/outlet tees less than 12 inches, and use of a sieve analysis).
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by jewell and second by mayhew, these variances were unanimously approved by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Deny the building permit application for an in-law apartment at 67 Autumn Lane in its present form.
